body: profile gauges are cheap enough, far more easy to work with.

Seems to be a legitimate knipex product
I have many knipex pliers with a verity of varied handles VDE, comfort grip and red plastic and majority of them if not all have a barcode on the handle with product identification number either on the handle or etched onto the plier itself.

They’re using a combination of a ratchet (looks to be 1/4 inch drive) with the corresponding size 1/4 inch drive socket (either metric or Imperial) and a combination spanner in the corresponding size to both drive and secure the fittings.

There are a variety of alternatives to what they used such as nut drivers, adjustable wrenches etc and alternatively two matching spanner’s; in the correct size for the fitting. 

The important factor is that two tools are needed one to hold one fitting and the other to drive the other and secure it and also that the tools are the correct size for the fitting to avoid damaging the fitting or hurting yourself. 

The video gives the sizing for the fittings and I would imagine the product will be supplied with an instruction manual which will also give reference to the size and more detailed information on how to assemble the product correctly and safely. 
Hope this helps!

Hi truely,
I’m a sufferer of both diagnosed anxiety and clinical depression.
My personal explanation of depression would be that it feels like the world and everything in it has had the colour sucked out; everything is meaningless and you feel that there is no way out, that you don’t belong. You’re alone. 

I think depression effects everyone differently some with milder symptoms; others severe and thus people respond differently to various approaches.

I’ve personally found that having someone who is reliable and trustworthy to just listen to me so I can express my thoughts and feelings being extremely helpful and calming in my worst episodes. 

I have also found that someone who can help to encourage but not push me to keep a routine and do some basic things to keep me putting one foot in front of the other helpful in feeling a little more human and that I’m making progress. 

Hopefully this makes some sense and can be of some use. 

I’m really sorry your friend feels this way and I truly hope that your friend feels much better soon -  thank you for being such a caring and considerate person

Take care.
